interpretation: The repaired deterministic representation can explain and select every affected test in the already-observed Flask corpus while remaining below the preregistered selection ceiling.
Because the representation was repaired using failures observed on this same corpus, this is calibration evidence rather than independent confirmation.
The result supports exhausting deterministic graph relations before introducing an inference layer, but requires a fresh holdout corpus before making a generalization claim.
